appearances.snippet: He didn't greenlight. To turn Gaza into a Trump golf course with the maitre d' being Jared Kushner with $4 billion in Saudi money.

verification.notes: Joe Biden did not approve the Trump administration's 2026 Gaza redevelopment plan; current reporting identifies Trump and Jared Kushner as central promoters. Describing it as a Trump golf course financed by Kushner's Saudi-backed fund is rhetorical conflation: the published plan discusses tourism and redevelopment but not a documented Trump-branded golf course or use of that fund.

sources.title: Kushner presents Gaza redevelopment vision under Trump's plan
sources.relevance: Attributes the current redevelopment vision to Trump and Kushner while not documenting the golf-course and Saudi-fund details.
